content: निबन्धः .²1 Binding, tying, fastening. .²2 Attachment, intentness; दैवी संपद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता <ls>Bg. 16. 5</ls>. .²3 Composing, writing down. .²4 Literary composition or treatise, work; प्रत्यक्षरश्लेषमयप्रबन्धविन्यासवैदग्ध्यनिधिर्निबन्धं चक्रे <ls>Vās.</ls> .²5 A compendium. .²6 Restraint, obstruction, confinement. .²7 Suppression of urine. .²8 A bond, fetter. .²9 A grant of property, an assignment of cattle, money <ab>&c.</ab> for support; भूर्या पितामहोपात्ता निबन्धो द्रव्यमेव वा <ls>Y. 2. 121</ls>. .²10 Fixed property. .²11 Foundation, origin. .²12 Cause, reason. .{@-धम्@} Song, singing.
